slug: 2026-01-19 South Sudan introduces digital payment system for passports after supply crisis

facts.fact: The National Revenue Authority chief said cash at immigration offices was abolished and passport and national ID fees are paid through a bank-linked digital system (Sudans Post).
facts.system: bank-linked digital payment system for passports and national ID

systems.system: bank-linked digital payment system for passports and national ID
systems.platform: commercial bank in the immigration compound
